promote_guide.what_masking_gives: Data-classification makes the grant-resolver projection value-aware: instead of merely filtering which FIELDS a caller sees, it now also controls what VALUE they see for sensitive fields based on the caller's clearance level. The four transforms are: drop (field omitted entirely), redact (replaced with '[redacted]'), partial (last-4 digits/chars shown, rest masked), hash (deterministic 8-byte djb2 digest). Clearance levels map from public → internal → confidential → restricted. The governed flag on the resource determines whether version-boundary failures are fail-closed (governed=true: drop whole facet) or pass raw (governed=false: legacy state-U back-compat floor).
